column7: Declared WithNamedLock acquisition order, enforced in test builds (internal/core/storage/named_lock_order.go), with TestNamedLockOrder_EveryCallSiteKeyHasAFamily (internal/core) requiring every call-site key to belong to a declared family. In-process mutexes taken under a named lock are not covered (#2694). Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
